details.reason: The policy asks for it only on a fix, and this change is not classified as one, so it is not needed. This does not stop meets_policy.

params.name: load
params.run: set -e; base="$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)"; files="$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM "$base" HEAD | grep -E '^relay/test/[^/]+[.]test[.]js$' || true)"; if [ -z "$files" ]; then echo "No relay test file was added or changed."; exit 0; fi; npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund > /dev/null; pids=""; for i in 1 2 3; do TEST_SLOTS=0 node relay/test/run.js $files > "load-$i.log" 2>&1 & pids="$pids $!"; done; code=0; for p in $pids; do wait "$p" || code=1; done; tail -n 20 load-1.log load-2.log load-3.log; exit $code

flaky_tests: relay/test/rollback.test.js > Update goes back to the last good commit when the new relay fails its check > a fail: the new relay does not start, so Update checks out the last good commit and restarts on it
relay/test/rollback.test.js > Update goes back to the last good commit when the new relay fails its check > and Update pulls nothing more until a person checks out main, and says why
